headline: Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Limited: 53rd CoC Meeting for Fernhill Project CIRP
sum: Ansal Properties & Infrastructure disclosed to NSE the minutes of its 53rd Committee of Creditors meeting for the Fernhill Project CIRP held on 15 June 2026. The disclosure signals ongoing resolution proceedings under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
detail: Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Limited intimated the NSE of CoC minutes for its Fernhill Project corporate insolvency resolution process. The 53rd CoC meeting was held on 15 June 2026, indicating the company remains in active CIRP with substantive creditor engagement. Real-estate CIRP proceedings frequently span multiple CoC cycles to evaluate resolution plans, asset realisations, and creditor acceptance thresholds. The publicly disclosed minutes underline the regulator's insolvency transparency mandate and the case's materiality to public shareholders.
